description: This file defines the TypeDescriptor class, which encapsulates type information for Hive's SQL types, including methods for conversion, size, precision, and qualifiers.

classes.name: TypeDescriptor
classes.description: Represents a data type descriptor in Hive, including type, name, and qualifiers, with methods for conversion and size/precision info.

methods.name: TypeDescriptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a Type object.

methods.name: TypeDescriptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing from a TTypeDesc object.

methods.name: TypeDescriptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing from a type name string.

methods.name: toTTypeDesc
methods.description: Converts the descriptor to a TTypeDesc Thrift object.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name, either explicitly set or derived from the Type object.

methods.name: setTypeQualifiers
methods.description: Sets the TypeQualifiers for this descriptor.

methods.name: getColumnSize
methods.description: Returns the column size based on type, such as precision or character length.

methods.name: getPrecision
methods.description: Returns the maximum precision for numeric types.

methods.name: getDecimalDigits
methods.description: Returns the number of fractional digits for the type.
